past.title: SILENT DISCO - Battle of The Groove
past.body:
GrooveMates returns to HOB for a night of music, community, and straight vibes!

Grab a headset, choose your channel, and vibe out with us as our GrooveMates DJs go head to head in this silent disco battle 🔥
We’ll be bringing back our vendor market featuring local small businesses and creatives you’ll love!

Free Entry - $10 headset rental

RSVP HERE for FREE

past.title: HOBAWEEN with Full Fledged Unit
past.body:
Spooky SZN has officially commenced! 

Something wicked (and well-dressed) this way comes!

Join us Halloween night for live music by Full Fledged Unit from 7-10 pm, and strut your spooky stuff in our Costume Contest! 

Costume Contest check in at 8:30, winners announced by the band at 10! 

Check in - South Side window with bartender Cortney!

  • You will receive a number to wear

  • Audience will place their votes in a bucket

First, second and third place will be announced by the band!
